intent: Turn the `Pre-commit checks` workflow green again on main, and register the new punchme app in the shared launcher-icon family.
scope: Non-goal: changing any gate's rules, or restyling the existing icon family
changes: pre-commit.yml now checks out kuhyx/utils into .utils/ and points UTILS_ROOT at it. The md-naming and file-length hooks are thin shims that exec the real gate out of that repo; a runner has no ~/utils, so both failed with 'shared gate not found at /home/runner/utils/...' and the workflow has been red since 2026-08-24. The dedicated md-naming.yml already did this checkout — this copies the same approach rather than inventing one.
Registered app_icons entry 'punchme' (shared family accent #B8862E, glyph punch-card, linux=False since the app is Android-only).

Added the _PUNCH_CARD glyph: a time card with a clipped corner, a column of four punched holes and three ruled lines. The first draft put two holes above two wide slots and read unmistakably as a face (eyes over teeth) at every size, which is why the holes are now a vertical column.

verification.evidence: Exit 0. With UTILS_ROOT=/nonexistent the same shim fails with 'shared gate not found at /nonexistent/scripts/check_md_naming.sh', so the override is what the fix relies on and it is proven in both directions.
44 passed. test_registry.py iterates every entry in APPS, so the new punchme entry's accent, glyph reference and repo path are all asserted without a bespoke test.
100% on every app_icons module, including _glyph_art_more.py with the new glyph.
All hooks passed, including pylint, bandit and 'pytest with coverage enforcement'.
Wrote 6 asset files and regenerated the Android mipmaps with no safe-box warning. Rendered at full size, circle-masked and 48dp and reviewed each; legible at all three.

risks: The utils checkout pins no ref, so a breaking change to the shared gate lands in this repo's CI without a commit here. That matches how md-naming.yml already behaves, so this change does not add a new class of risk.
CI_GREEN_SKIP was set on the commit because the red baseline the gate objects to is the very thing this commit fixes.
rollback: git revert the commit; the workflow returns to its previous (red) state and no other behaviour changes.
After rollback, confirm `Pre-commit checks` is the only red workflow and that app_icons tests still pass, since the icon change is independent of the CI fix.
